# nut battery

Show battery charge and runtime, or run a guarded self-test

```text
Show battery charge and runtime, or run a guarded self-test

Usage: nut battery [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  test
          Run a guarded battery self-test on the operator credential

Options:
      --color <WHEN>
          Color output policy [default: auto] [possible values: auto, always, never]
      --ascii
          Use ASCII symbols and bars
      --ups <UPS>
          UPS name (defaults to the selected host configuration, or `primary`)
  -j, --json
          Emit machine-readable JSON where supported
      --upsd-address <ADDRESS>
          Loopback upsd address (defaults to host configuration, or 127.0.0.1)
      --upsd-port <PORT>
          Loopback upsd port (defaults to host configuration, or 3493)
  -v, --verbose
          Include additional diagnostic detail
  -c, --config <PATH>
          Read host settings from this file
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## nut battery test

Run a guarded battery self-test on the operator credential

```text
Run a guarded battery self-test on the operator credential

Usage: nut battery test [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --color <WHEN>
          Color output policy [default: auto] [possible values: auto, always, never]
      --stop
          Stop a running test instead of starting one
      --ascii
          Use ASCII symbols and bars
  -j, --json
          Emit machine-readable JSON where supported
  -v, --verbose
          Include additional diagnostic detail
  -c, --config <PATH>
          Read host settings from this file
  -h, --help
          Print help
```
